description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read the whole portfolio as one small digest (at most 16 000 characters, about 4 000 tokens) instead of the enormous get_context union: asOf, the value/cash/day-change/P-L totals with the per-account split, time-weighted and money-weighted performance, the six risk headlines (max drawdown, current drawdown, volatility p.a., Sharpe, Sortino, worst day), the ten largest holdings by weight with weight, value, day change and total gain, the asset-class and sector allocation with target drift where targets are set, the trade plan's buy/sell/net totals and order counts, the next five calendar events, the data-quality warning counts by kind, the strategy profile, the central-bank policy rates with the risk regime, the user's own trades of the context window (newest first), the subscription tier and its limits, and the user's saved memories and standing notes in full. include ⊆ [memories, notes] LISTS WHICH of the two optional blocks to keep — both when it is omitted, only the ones named when it is given, and neither for include: []. Every amount is in displayCurrency and every field ending in Pct is a percentage. Start here, then call a focused view for the detail; trimmed names any list that had to be shortened to fit.
name: get_core
title: Portfolio overview
